summary: Port native 3D shape bounds and brute-force broad phase with batch layouts, filters and capacity-safe atomic reservations.
regressions: 78 live Rust differential cases cover all shape tags, negative-zero/identity rotations, degenerate capsule, empty convex range, batch/tile boundaries, interaction modes, same-body/adjacency filtering, touching/scaled prediction, append prefix and capacity overflow.
Fault injection rejects illegal/duplicate pairs, incorrect counters, input mutations, invalid geometry, padding and guards.
Rust repeat-export regression preserves saved runtime output while keeping an explicit stable input ABI.
C float abs lowering and Metal reserved type-name regressions are exercised by world-bound execution cases.
differences: Floating bounds retain existing f32 tolerances. Pair reservation order and overflow subset may differ; eligibility/count/uniqueness remain exact.
IEEE sign-bit absolute value expresses Rust f32 abs on targets where TileLang C cannot lower tirx.fabs.
Serial-pair path shares the predicate with the parallel entry point; this preserves behavior but does not claim matching performance.
Full matrix refresh also covers unreconciled TGS frame composition (0026) and repeat-export metadata fix (0027).
No CPU geometry fallback, Ascend hardware claim, full collision pipeline claim or broad completion claim.
